card.name: Section numbers in highlights citations
card.fires_on: The leading digit of a section number (like 5 in 5.1 or 8 in 8.4) inside a parenthetical list of cross-references at the end of a Highlights sentence. It fires just before the closing parenthesis becomes likely.

modes.label: Leading digit of section number
modes.description: The first digit of a number such as 5.1 or 7.2 in a bracketed list of section references.

modes.label: Digit after the decimal point
modes.description: The digit after the dot in a section number, shortly before the list closes.

card.writes: It favors a closing parenthesis and line end after the citation, and suppresses plain newlines.
card.plain: It marks the section numbers cited in parentheses at the end of a summary sentence in a drug label's highlights.
